question.stem: In the figure, \(DE\parallel BC\) and \([ADE]:[ADC]=1:4\). Find \([DEC]:[BDC]\).
question.solution: Triangles ADE and ADC have bases AE and AC on the same line and a common altitude from D. Thus \(AE/AC=[ADE]/[ADC]=1/4\). Since \(DE\parallel BC\), similarity gives \(DE/BC=AE/AC=1/4\). Triangles DEC and BDC have bases DE and BC with equal heights between the parallel lines, so \([DEC]:[BDC]=1:4\).
question.solutionZh: 先用同高三角形：\([ADE]/[ADC]=AE/AC=1/4\)。由 \(DE\parallel BC\) 及相似三角形得 \(DE/BC=1/4\)。再以 DE、BC 為底，兩三角形在平行線之間等高，所以 \([DEC]:[BDC]=1:4\)。

question.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a parallelogram. E is the midpoint of AB; F and G lie on CD with \(DF=FG=GC\). BG and CE intersect at H. If \([BCH]=6\text{ cm}^2\), find the area of EFGH.
question.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是平行四邊形，E 是 AB 的中點，F、G 三等分 CD，且 \(DF=FG=GC\)。BG 與 CE 交於 H。若 \([BCH]=6\text{ cm}^2\)，求 EFGH 的面積。
question.solution: Normalize \(A=(0,0),B=(1,0),C=(1,1),D=(0,1)\). Then \(E=(1/2,0),F=(1/3,1),G=(2/3,1),H=(4/5,3/5)\). Base-height subtraction gives \([BCH]=1/10,[EFGH]=4/15\) of the parallelogram. Thus \(6(4/15)/(1/10)=16\text{ cm}^2\).
question.solutionZh: 把平行四邊形面積設為 1。按等分點定位交點，得 \(H=(4/5,3/5)\)（以相鄰兩邊為座標方向）。由底高及分割可得 \([BCH]=1/10,[EFGH]=4/15\)，所求為 \(6\times(4/15)/(1/10)=16\text{ cm}^2\)。

question.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a parallelogram and E lies on AB. EC and BD intersect at F. If \([DEF]=20\text{ cm}^2\), find \([CBF]\).
question.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是平行四邊形，E 在 AB 上。EC 與 BD 交於 F。若 \([DEF]=20\text{ cm}^2\)，求 \([CBF]\)。
question.solution: Triangles DBC and DEC share base DC and have equal heights because E and B lie on AB parallel DC. Subtract common triangle DFC: \([CBF]=[DEF]=20\text{ cm}^2\).
question.solutionZh: 先認出等高同底。\([DBC]=[DEC]\)，因兩者同底 DC，而 B、E 在平行於 DC 的 AB 上。兩邊扣去共同的 \(\triangle DFC\)，得 \([CBF]=[DEF]=20\text{ cm}^2\)。

question.stem: In the figure, ABC, CDE and EFA are straight lines. \(BF\parallel CE\), \(AB:BC=2:3\) and \(CD:DE=1:4\). If \([ABF]=4\), find the area of BDEF.
question.stemZh: 如圖，A、B、C 共線，C、D、E 共線，E、F、A 共線；\(BF\parallel CE\)，\(AB:BC=2:3\)，\(CD:DE=1:4\)。若 \([ABF]=4\)，求 BDEF 的面積。
question.solution: Similarity gives \([ABF]/[ACE]=(2/5)^2=4/25\), so \([ACE]=25\). Triangles BCD and ACE share angle C, with side ratios \(CB/CA=3/5,CD/CE=1/5\). Hence \([BCD]=3\) and \([BDEF]=25-4-3=18\).

question.stem: In the figure, F lies on BC with \(BF:FC=2:3\). D lies on AC; BD cuts AF at E with \(AE:EF=2:1\). If \([ABE]=12\text{ cm}^2\), find the area of CDEF.
question.stemZh: 如圖，F 在 BC 上且 \(BF:FC=2:3\)。D 在 AC 上，BD 與 AF 交於 E，且 \(AE:EF=2:1\)。若 \([ABE]=12\text{ cm}^2\)，求 CDEF 的面積。
question.solution: Since AE:EF=2:1, \([BEF]=6,[ABF]=18\). Thus \([ACF]=27\). To locate D use triangle ABC with \(BF/FC=2/3,AE/EF=2\): base-height ratios give \(AD:DC=4:5\). Hence \([ABD]=20,[ADE]=8\) and \([CDEF]=[ACF]-[ADE]=27-8=19\text{ cm}^2\).

question.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a rectangle. E is the midpoint of BC. AC and ED intersect at F. Find \([AEB]:[FCE]\).
question.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是長方形，E 是 BC 的中點，AC 與 ED 交於 F。求 \([AEB]:[FCE]\)。
question.solution: Triangles FCE and FAD are similar with \(CE:AD=1:2\), hence F is at one-third of the rectangle height above BC. Since \(BE=CE\), triangles AEB and FCE have equal bases and height ratio 3:1. Therefore the area ratio is 3:1.
question.solutionZh: 先由 \(\triangle FCE\sim\triangle FAD\) 得 \(CE:AD=1:2\)，所以 F 離 BC 的高度為長方形高度的 \(1/3\)。又 \(BE=CE\)，故兩三角形的面積比等於高比，即 3:1。

question.stem: The figure shows trapezium ABCD with \(AD\parallel BC\). AFE, BFD and BEC are straight lines. \(BE:EC=BC:AD=1:3\) and \([ABF]=12\text{ cm}^2\). Find the area of CEFD.
question.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是梯形，\(AD\parallel BC\)。A、F、E 共線，B、F、D 共線，B、E、C 共線；\(BE:EC=BC:AD=1:3\)，且 \([ABF]=12\text{ cm}^2\)。求 CEFD 的面積。
question.solution: Set BC=1, AD=3, BE=1/4 and height=1 in affine coordinates. Choose \(B=(0,0),C=(1,0),A=(0,1),D=(3,1),E=(1/4,0)\). Then \(F=(3/13,1/13)\). The normalized areas are \([ABF]=3/26,[CEFD]=51/104\). Scale by \(12/(3/26)=104\) to obtain \(51\text{ cm}^2\).
question.solutionZh: 用平行底作座標方向：令 \(BC=1,AD=3,BE=1/4\)、高為 1。由兩直線相交得 \(F=(3/13,1/13)\)。底高分割得 \([ABF]=3/26,[CEFD]=51/104\)。實際面積比例因子為 104，故答案為 \(51\text{ cm}^2\)。

question.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a square. E and F are midpoints of AD and AB. G lies on BC with \(GC=3BG\); H lies on DC with \(HC=2DH\). If \([BFG]=3\text{ cm}^2\), find the area of EFGH.
question.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是正方形，E、F 分別是 AD、AB 的中點。G 在 BC 上且 \(GC=3BG\)；H 在 DC 上且 \(HC=2DH\)。若 \([BFG]=3\text{ cm}^2\)，求 EFGH 的面積。
question.solution: Let the square have area S. Then \([BFG]=\tfrac12\cdot\tfrac12\cdot\tfrac14S=S/16\), so S=48. The four corner triangles have total fraction \(1/8+1/16+1/4+1/12=25/48\). Thus \([EFGH]=48(1-25/48)=23\text{ cm}^2\).
question.solutionZh: 先由 \([BFG]=\tfrac12\times\tfrac12\times\tfrac14S=S/16=3\) 得正方形面積 \(S=48\)。四個角的三角形面積佔比分別為 \(1/8,1/16,1/4,1/12\)。扣去後得 \([EFGH]=48\times23/48=23\text{ cm}^2\)。

question.stem: In triangle ABC, P lies on AB and Q lies on AC. \(AP:PB=2:1\) and \(AQ:QC=1:3\). Find \([BCP]:[BCQ]\).
question.stemZh: 在 \(\triangle ABC\) 中，P、Q 分別在 AB、AC 上，\(AP:PB=2:1\)，\(AQ:QC=1:3\)。求 \([BCP]:[BCQ]\)。
question.solution: Both triangles use BC as base. Their heights above BC are \(1/3\) and \(3/4\) of the height from A. Thus \([BCP]:[BCQ]=\tfrac13:\tfrac34=4:9\).
question.solutionZh: 兩三角形共用底 BC。P、Q 離 BC 的高度分別為 A 的 \(1/3\) 及 \(3/4\)，故面積比為 \(\tfrac13:\tfrac34=4:9\)。

question.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a trapezium with \(AD\parallel BC\) and \(AD:BC=1:3\). E lies on BC so ABED is a parallelogram; F is the midpoint of BC. DE and AF intersect at G. If \([EGF]=7\text{ cm}^2\), find the area of ABCD.
question.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是梯形，\(AD\parallel BC\)，\(AD:BC=1:3\)。E 在 BC 上使 ABED 成為平行四邊形；F 是 BC 的中點。DE 與 AF 交於 G。若 \([EGF]=7\text{ cm}^2\)，求梯形 ABCD 的面積。
question.solution: Normalize AD=BE=1, BC=3 and height h. Then EF=1/2. Similar triangles GAD and GFE give \(GF:GA=EF:AD=1:2\), so G is at height h/3 above BC. Hence \([EGF]=\tfrac12\cdot\tfrac12\cdot h/3=h/12\) while \([ABCD]=(1+3)h/2=2h\). The factor is 24, giving \(168\text{ cm}^2\).
question.solutionZh: 令 \(AD=BE=1,BC=3\)，梯形高為 h，則 \(EF=1/2\)。由相似三角形得 G 離 BC 的高度為 \(h/3\)，所以 \([EGF]=h/12\)，而梯形面積為 \(2h\)，是前者的 24 倍。答案 \(7\times24=168\text{ cm}^2\)。

question.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a trapezium with \(AD\parallel BC\) and \(AD:BC=3:2\). E lies on AD with \(AE:AD=1:3\). AC and BE intersect at F. If \([BCF]=8\text{ cm}^2\), find the area of ABCD.
question.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是梯形，\(AD\parallel BC\)，\(AD:BC=3:2\)。E 在 AD 上，且 \(AE:AD=1:3\)。AC 與 BE 交於 F。若 \([BCF]=8\text{ cm}^2\)，求梯形 ABCD 的面積。
question.solution: Let AD=3, BC=2 and height h, so AE=1. Similar triangles AEF and CBF give \(AF:FC=AE:BC=1:2\). Thus F has height 2h/3 above BC and \([BCF]=2h/3\). The trapezium area is \(5h/2\), giving ratio \(15/4\) and area \(8\times15/4=30\text{ cm}^2\).
question.solutionZh: 令 \(AD=3,BC=2\)，高為 h，得 \(AE=1\)。由 \(\triangle AEF\sim\triangle CBF\) 得 \(AF:FC=1:2\)，故 F 離 BC 的高度為 \(2h/3\)。\([BCF]=2h/3\)，梯形面積為 \(5h/2\)，所以答案為 \(8\times15/4=30\text{ cm}^2\)。
